positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Release Manager
positions.description:
Ensure application changes are managed as they pass through the various testing environments and into production.
Plan large quarterly releases, conducts meetings with developers, shared services, business testers and management. 
Execute changes as needed. Create appropriate Guardian Service Center tickets (releases, features, changes, C-tasks, etc.). 
Ensure all audit requirements are met. 
Work with development, business areas, and testing teams to schedule changes, make sure all audit requirements are met, and ensures the changes are made successfully.
Ensure that testing environments are always functional. Resolve deployment problems, disk space issues, and coordination with shared services where necessary. 
Documentation – Ensures that all procedures and processes are fully documented and maintained current.
Work with Production Support Team to address problems that have an impact on multiple production users.  Coordinates with the various teams within Guardian to resolve these problems in a timely manner.

positions.title: Software Quality Assurance Analyst
positions.description:
Serve as a key member of software development team
Facilitated test case development, test execution, bug
reporting, and test report delivery

Engaged in daily Scrum meetings, backlog refinement,
sprint planning, sprint reviews, and retrospectives

Manage production releases by creation of timelines,
scheduling business testers, and creation of release notes

Act as a liaison between the Development team and the
various business units

Compile and build application packages using Microsoft
Visual Studio

Executing SQL queries to ensure the data integrity by
checking various kinds of constraints

Successfully install and configure multiple test
environments using virtual machines

Collaborate with Customer Support troubleshooting complex
functionality problems on production sites

positions.title: Deskside Support Lead Technician
positions.description:
Executive support
Extensive customer-facing white glove service
Experience working with remote and mobile users
Configure personal devices, including laptops, desktops, mobiles, video and teleconferencing devices, and onboarding 
Install and configure enterprise software
Setup, maintain and troubleshoot Windows 10 laptop computers
Create documentation for Help Desk staff 
Asset Management 
Coordinate internal office moves
Network Troubleshooting
Configure Cisco network switches  
Install network infrastructure for building move

positions.title: Support Analyst
positions.description:
Offered support to students with Microsoft Office Suite and Adobe Acrobat.
Facilitated reaching counselors, locating resources on the E - campus site, and answering general questions regarding classes.
Resolved technical issues by phone and Technical Support Mail using HEAT and Service Desk ticketing systems.
Implemented procedure exceptions to accommodate unusual customer requests.
Authored technical articles for the Knowledge base system using SharePoint as well as verify articles for accuracy.

positions.title: Computer Operator
positions.description:
-  Support end users in resolving issues related to desktop and hardware support as well as IT security and account provisioning.
-  Datacenter monitoring and server management including backup systems (Full, incremental, journal and ignite backups).
- Created and documented innovative processes which brought efficiencies to the operations team. 
-  Established training plan for new and existing employees on said procedures.
-  Prepared backup tapes to be sent offsite daily for storage in the event of disaster recovery.
-  Resolved technical issues by phone using HEAT ticketing system.
-  Roll out new hospital applications.
-  Aided other teams with system upgrades and special backups.
-  Completed multiple projects for management and other teams.
-  Created user accounts for multiple systems.
